CONTRACT MANUFACTURING SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Contract Manufacturing Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of January 15, 2024 (the "Effective Date"), by and between Northwind Devices, Inc. ("Customer") and Harborline Manufacturing, LLC ("Manufacturer").

The initial term begins on the Effective Date and continues until January 14, 2027.

1. Definitions

1.1 "Business Day" means any day other than a Saturday or Sunday. The parties agree that public holidays are not excluded.

1.2 "Firm Period" means the first ninety (90) days of the then-current rolling forecast.

1.3 "NCNR Materials" means components and materials that are non-cancellable and non-returnable once Manufacturer places the purchase order.

1.4 "Excess and Obsolete" or "E&O" means inventory that exceeds Customer's then-current forecast or that Customer no longer requires because of a design or program change.

2. Pricing

2.1 Unit Prices. The unit price for product NW-100 is USD 12.40 per unit.

2.2 Payment. Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days after the invoice date (Net 45).

2.3 Adjustment Cap. Any annual price adjustment shall not exceed three percent (3%) of the prior unit price.

2.4 Price Notice. Manufacturer shall give written notice at least sixty (60) days before each anniversary of the Effective Date before an annual price adjustment may take effect.

3. Forecast and NCNR

3.1 Firm Period. The first ninety (90) days of each rolling forecast are non-cancellable and non-returnable (NCNR).

3.2 NCNR Purchase. Customer shall purchase all NCNR Materials that Manufacturer procured in reliance on the Firm Period, as defined in Section 1.3.

3.3 Flexibility. Customer may reduce the forecast outside the Firm Period by up to twenty percent (20%) without creating NCNR liability.

4. Excess and Obsolete Inventory

4.1 E&O Liability. Customer shall be liable for Excess and Obsolete unique materials at Manufacturer's actual cost and for finished goods at the contract price when the Excess and Obsolete inventory results from a forecast reduction outside the flexibility in Section 3.3.

4.2 Standard Materials. Customer shall be liable for Excess and Obsolete standard materials only when those materials were purchased within sixty (60) days of the forecast demand date.

5. Notices and Deadlines

5.1 Method. All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing.

5.2 Termination Notice. Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by written notice at least thirty (30) days before the termination date.

5.3 E&O Notice. Customer shall give written notice of claimed Excess and Obsolete inventory no later than fifteen (15) business days after the end of the calendar quarter in which the inventory became Excess and Obsolete.

6. Cross-References

6.1 Defined Terms. NCNR Materials has the meaning given in Section 1.3, and the Firm Period has the meaning given in Section 1.2.

7. Survival

7.1 Surviving Terms. Sections 3, 4, 5, and 7 survive expiration or termination of this Agreement.
